sloka: स ददर्श महातेजा रावणः कपिसत्तमम् ।रक्षोभिर्विकृताकारैः कृष्यमाणमितस्ततः ।। ५.४८.५९।।।।
transliteration: sa dadarśa mahātejā rāvaṇaḥ kapisattamam ।rakṣobhirvikṛtākāraiḥ kṛṣyamāṇamitastataḥ ।। 5.48.59।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman the best of monkeys also saw the demon king who had both splendour and strength, radiating brilliance like the Sun.
